body.objective: Proof-first extension from l=2 to generic l>=2: derive the tensor-harmonic dependence of the Ricci-to-Bach exact sequence, ingoing dimension, invariant cross pairing, and leading reconstruction/norm-selection structure, separating exceptional harmonics before running finite checks.
body.stop_condition: Land a symbolic-l theorem and independent verifier for the operator composition, ingoing dimension count, invariant pairing rank/cross scalar, and leading asymptotic reconstruction in both parities, or certify the first l-dependent obstruction and its exact exceptional set. Finite sampled harmonics may falsify or control the proof but cannot establish generic l.
body.current_gate: generic-l theorem after l=2 invariant form and symbolic cross scalar
body.forbid: no Conflux; no induction from sampled l alone; no folding l=0 or l=1 into the generic theorem; no complex-frequency, stability, QNM, ringdown, scattering, positivity, particle, or nonlinear claim
body.resource_hint: Derive the l dependence from tensor-harmonic identities before sampling. Conflux remains disabled pending a Schwarzschild-specific acceptance gate.
notes: Mathematical target: a generic-l exact-sequence and pairing theorem with l=0,1 isolated as exceptional representations.
Candidate theorem: for every l>=2 the two parities share a fixed extension/pairing normal form with explicitly l-dependent cross scalar and controlled leading reconstruction class.
Proof obligations: derive all angular eigenvalue factors, prove rank constancy away from an exact exceptional set, and transport the l=2 current identities without mode sampling.
Counterexample strategy: exact l=0, l=1, l=2 controls plus roots of every l-dependent pivot or determinant; a finite list of successful l values never proves the theorem.
Certificate boundary: complex omega, a complete asymptotic phase space, stability, QNMs, ringdown, scattering, and quantization remain open.
